work_packages.acceptance_evidence: Actual timestamp, output/code/model hashes, source-bound stage resume and change detection; actual strategy-removal controls and labelled cost/stress sensitivity. Future scoring requires later supplied observations; no prospective investment result is claimed.

work_packages.acceptance_evidence: Exact role profiles, no substitution, persistent failed-call charges and typed schema output; actual three-model benchmark and historical adoption remain unproven.
